messages:
Ivy R: Heads-up — starter-kit flake: structured function-call payloads fail schema validation but only when auth retry occurs. Validator says "missing required property 'metadata'" even though payload had metadata in first request.
Marco D: Can you paste the raw received body from server logs?
Ivy R: Logged body (as bytes->utf8):
```
"{\"tool\":\"summarize\",\"input\":{\"text\":\"lorem\"},\"metadata\":{\"user\":\"u123\"}\n}"
```
Jun H: Looks like a double-quoted string with a trailing newline escaped. Where's that coming from?
Olivia P: Repro'd: flow is json-mode helper serializes JSON + appends '\n' delimiter to help streaming. On 401->retry, the retry layer calls JSON.stringify again (because it checks 'body' is object), producing a quoted-string containing the escaped newline. That makes the server's strict validator see the payload as a string, not an object, so required properties appear missing.
Marco D: Also signing mismatch: Py signs Buffer.from(json + '\n'), TS signs json without newline, retry changes it again -> signature mismatch and token rejection.
Jun H: Proposed fixes:
- In retry middleware: if typeof body === 'string' || Buffer.isBuffer(body) then send as-is; don't re-stringify.
- For signing: sign over the exact bytes used to build the request (Buffer). Canonicalize json-mode helpers across SDKs to include newline consistently.
- Add unit tests: one that simulates 401 then 200 and asserts server received raw Buffer equals expected (including newline), and one to ensure function-call payload remains an object (not string) after retry.
Olivia P: Small code snippet I'll submit:
```
// retry.ts
const payload = (typeof opts.body === 'string' || Buffer.isBuffer(opts.body)) ? opts.body : JSON.stringify(opts.body)
const sig = sign(Buffer.isBuffer(payload) ? payload : Buffer.from(String(payload)))
await sendRequest({ ...opts, body: payload })
```
Ivy R: Also found an ancillary bug: our function-call helper coerces fields typed as optional null into omitted keys when converting to compacted JSON; combined with double-encode it can turn {metadata:null} -> missing in final object. Add test for null-presence.
ci-bot: PR #5342 opened by olivia-p: "ts: avoid double-serialize in retry; sign canonical payload; add parity tests" -> https://ci.redwood/p/5342
Marco D: I'll add a short docs blurb to devex: "json-mode helpers and middleware must agree on byte-level canonicalization; don't re-serialize".
Ivy R: TY! Once PR merges we'll re-run starter-kit and monitor flaky tests. :rocket:
